messages:
nina: Kickoff for MetalCore joint bench — focus: perf/W + sustained tail throughput for marketplace artifact. Need test matrix and telemetry contract.
omar: Suggested kernel knobs: MC_KERNEL_TUNE=aggr, SCHED_BIAS=low_latency, and quant modes q8_dynamic / q6_sparse. We'll run 3 seeds x 4 repeats per config.
paul_hw: We can supply MetalCore rack (mc-rc1). Telemetry agent will push gzipped ndjson to s3://metalcore-bench/redwood/. Sample line: {"ts":1771234567,"node":"mc-rc1","power_w":755.4,"tokens":1200000,"mode":"efficiency","run_id":"mc-2026-04-02-01"}
bench-bot: Job queued: partners/metalcore-sweep (id: mc-2026-04-02-01). Est. 22h full matrix. :robot_face:
slo-bot: Proposed acceptance gates:
 - efficiency: >= 4.8 tokens/J at seq=384, p95 <= 130ms
 - throughput: >= 1.5M tokens/s sustained 90s, variance <= 9%
 - thermal: no throttle events, case delta <=10C
omar: We'll also capture kernel_sha and applied micro-patches. Will include a revert patch in the artifact bundle.
nina: CI: please output summary CSVs (tokens_per_sec, avg_power, tokens_per_joule, p95, p99.9) and graphs (power vs tps, latency CDF).
paul_hw: Acknowledged. locking test days Thu-Fri. I'll DM creds and add ssh users.
bench-bot: Artifacts will land in s3://metalcore-bench/redwood/artifacts/ on job completion.
nina: Draft of marketplace blurb & tech appendix owner: @omar. Omar, can you include the exact SKU list and kernel notes?
omar: Yup. Will drop kernel SHAs, SKU table, and a short changelog once runs finish.
slo-bot: Rollback playbook: if post-listing Dedicated customers see >5% drop in tokens/J for pinned artifact, pause rollout and open incident.
nina: Thanks team — smoke run tomorrow 10:00 PT, full sweep Thu-Fri. Meeting to sync results Mon 09:00 PT. :calendar:
